info.title: v2.order.handle_prescription_check
info.description: Use this API to approve or reject a prescription

post.description: Use this API to approve or reject a prescription

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: free_text
parameters.description: The reason for rejecting the prescription. Only usable when the reject_reason_code = 5.

parameters.name: group_id
parameters.description: The identify of product promotion. For items in one same add on deal promotion, the group_id should share the same id. For items not in add on deal promotion, the group_id should be 0. And the data is from group_id of shopee.orders.GetOrderDetails.

parameters.name: is_approved
parameters.description: Approve or reject the prescription. Available values: TRUE, FALSE.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for an item.

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: The list of invalid items that make the prescription get rejected

parameters.name: model_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a model of an item.

parameters.name: order_sn
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for an order.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: pharmacist_name
parameters.description: Full name of the pharmacist. Required for PH and ID Prescription Orders.

parameters.name: reject_reason_code
parameters.description: Reject reason code. Available values: 1 = Invalid Prescription (counterfeit/incorrect format) 2 = Incorrect Dosage 3 = No Prescription 4 = Unclear Image 5 = Free Text

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/order/handle_prescription_check?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "free_text": "-",
    "is_approved": true,
    "items": [
        {}
    ],
    "order_sn": "-",
    "pharmacist_name": "-"
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
